text: HyperFlow H3 Flash is Video Rebirth 's compressed, few-step version of MiniMax-H3 . It generates video and synchronized stereo audio together. Showcase · Weights (Hugging Face) · ComfyUI nodes · GGUF setup guide · 8-step LoRA for full-size MiniMax-H3 Decision rule: Use GGUF on PCs with 64 GB of system RAM or less. Use INT8 convrot on data-center GPUs, or on 24 GB+ RTX GPUs with at least 69 GiB of system RAM. All weights are in VideoRebirthAI/hyperflow-h3-flash . Full setup guide: integrations/README.md . Quick start: pip install git+https://github.com/Video-Rebirth/hyperflow-h3-flash pip install " hyperflow-h3-flash[hopper] @ git+https://github.com/Video-Rebirth/hyperflow-h3-flash " # H100 / H200: FlashAttention-3 pip install " hyperflow-h3-flash[fp8] @ git+https://github.com/Video-Rebirth/hyperflow-h3-flash " # --text-encoder-precision fp8 Requirements: Python 3.10+, PyTorch 2.6+ with CUDA and Triton ( pip install triton-windows on native Windows), an Ampere or newer NVIDIA GPU, and diffusers >= 0.40 . Multi-GPU ( --gpus > 1) requires Linux or WSL2 (raise memory= in %UserProfile%\.wslconfig on WSL2). First-run download: ~90 GB, or ~68 GB with --text-encoder-precision fp8 . This includes the MiniMax-H3 text encoder, VAEs, and the 16 GB HyperFlow INT8 transformer for the selected task. The 62 GB base transformer is never downloaded. First-run compilation: Triton INT8 kernels compile on first use (~1 min). Command Line Run hyperflow-h3-flash or python -m hyperflow_h3_flash : # Text to video + audio (t2va) hyperflow-h3-flash --prompt " A chef slides a steaming bowl of ramen across a wooden counter; rain taps on the window. " \ --output ramen.mp4 # First keyframe, or first + last keyframe (fl2va) hyperflow-h3-flash --prompt " ... " --image first.png --output clip.mp4 hyperflow-h3-flash --prompt " ... " --image first.png --last-image last.png --output clip.mp4 # Reference images, videos (with soundtrack), and audio clips in prompt order (ref2va) hyperflow-h3-flash --prompt " <Picture 1> walks through the scene of <Picture 2> ... " \ --reference person.png --reference scene.png --output clip.mp4 # 15 s clip, context-parallel across 4 GPUs (or --gpus auto for up to 4 visible GPUs) hyperflow-h3-flash --prompt " ... " --num-frames 360 --gpus 4 # 4 steps (speed), 6 steps (default), or 8 steps (quality) hyperflow-h3-flash --prompt " ... " --steps 4 Option Values / Default Description --steps 4 , 6 (default), 8 Sampling steps: 4 for speed, 6 balanced, 8 for quality. Sigma grids are in schedule.py . --num-frames 124 – 362 (default 124 ) Frame count at 24 fps ( 5.2 to 15 s ). Rounds up to 17n + 5 ( 360 becomes 362 ). --height , --width Multiples of 32 Default: 768 on the short edge. Follows the --image aspect ratio, or 16:9 for t2va . --reference Repeatable path ref2va inputs matching <Picture i> , <Video i> , and <Audio i> in prompt order. Limits: 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio clips, 12 total. --gpus ( --num-gpus ) 1 , 2 , 4 , 7 , 8 , auto Multi-GPU context and VAE tile parallelism. Re-launches automatically under torchrun . --offload auto (default), none , model , stream GPU memory placement. See Offload Modes . --text-encoder-precision bf16 (default), fp8 fp8 loads Qwen/Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct-FP8 . Saves ~22 GiB system RAM when offloading. Requires the [fp8] extra. --fp8-gemm triton (default), deepgemm GEMM backend of the fp8 text encoder. deepgemm needs Hopper or newer. --attention auto (default), sdpa , fa3 Uses FlashAttention-3 ( fa3 ) on Hopper when kernels is installed. Uses PyTorch sdpa otherwise. --block-chunk 0 (default), 16384 , ... Slices every token-wise op of a transformer block to bound VRAM activations. 16384 fits 15 s mixed ref2va in 24 GB VRAM. --weights , --subfolder , --base-model Hub ID or local path Override the transformer repo, task subfolder, or base MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 snapshot. examples/benchmark.py times every pipeline stage and per-GPU peak memory under torchrun . import torch from diffusers . utils . export_utils import encode_video from hyperflow_h3_flash import load_pipeline pipe = load_pipeline ( "t2va" ) # "fl2va": pass image=... (and last_image=...); "ref2va": pass references=[...] out = pipe ( prompt = "A chef slides a steaming bowl of ramen across a wooden counter." , num_frames = 124 , num_inference_steps = 6 , # 4, 6, or 8 generator = torch . Generator (). manual_seed ( 0 ), output = [ "videos" , "audio" , "sampling_rate" ], ) encode_video ( out [ "videos" ][ 0 ], fps = 24 , output_path = "ramen.mp4" , audio = out [ "audio" ][ 0 ], audio_sample_rate = out [ "sampling_rate" ], ) Multi-GPU under torchrun : Call torch.distributed.init_process_group("nccl") and pass device=f"cuda:{local_rank}" to load_pipeline . The pipeline shards execution across ranks and returns the full output on every rank. Standalone transformer ( AutoModel ): Each INT8 Hub folder ships self-contained model code. Load it without installing this package: from diffusers import AutoModel , then AutoModel.from_pretrained("VideoRebirthAI/hyperflow-h3-flash", subfolder="fl2va_int8_convrot", trust_remote_code=True, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16) . --offload sets GPU memory placement. auto (default) selects a mode from per-GPU VRAM: All runs are end-to-end at 1344×768 and 6 steps : text encoding, transformer, and video and audio VAE decode.
